title: Balanced KKL coordinate bound
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube with $n\ge2$ and $\mathbb Ef=0$. Some coordinate $i$ satisfies $I_i(f)\ge\log n/(30n)$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
replaced:
(Kahn--Kalai--Linial, 1988.) Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{-1,1\}$ be balanced,
i.e.\ $\E[f] = 0$, with $n \ge 2$. Then some coordinate $i$ has
\[
  \mathrm{Inf}_i[f] \;\ge\; \frac{\log n}{30\,n}.
\]
